evidence.quote: Geef jezelf de beste start – meld je uiterlijk op 1 mei aan via Studielink!

notes: Tuition for non-EU students is not stated for this specific programme. The general instellingscollegegeld of € 10,684 for 2026-2027 only applies to 'Associate degrees, bachelor- en masteropleidingen (m.u.v. de onderstaande opleidingen)', but it is not programme-specific and therefore left out. The application deadline of 1 May is a general date for most bachelor programmes, not necessarily for this programme; no programme-specific deadline found. The only start moment mentioned is September, but without a date.
